description: This is a base class for HTTP adapter integration tests in a Java project, providing various test scenarios for messaging, authentication, tenant/device management, and command handling using JUnit 5, Vert.x, and related libraries.

classes.name: HttpTestBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for HTTP adapter integration tests providing common setup, teardown, and test utility methods.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes HTTP clients and the test support helper before all tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test context, including tenant/device IDs and HTTP clients before each test.

methods.name: deleteObjects
methods.description: Cleans up objects from the registry after each test.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the test support helper after all tests.

methods.name: commandAndControlVariants
methods.description: Provides a stream of different command-and-control endpoint configurations for parameterized tests.

methods.name: commandAndControlVariantsForTestsWithGatewayMappingDisabled
methods.description: Filters variants where gateway mapping is disabled for specific tests.

methods.name: getEndpointUri
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the specific endpoint URI used in tests.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Abstract method to create a message consumer for a given tenant.

methods.name: testUploadMessagesUsingBasicAuth
methods.description: Tests uploading messages via HTTP Basic Auth and consuming via AMQP.

methods.name: testUploadMessagesViaGateway
methods.description: Tests message upload via gateway scenario and AMQP consumption.

methods.name: testUploadMessagesUsingClientCertificate
methods.description: Tests uploading messages authenticated via client certificate.

methods.name: testUploadFailsForNonMatchingTrustAnchor
methods.description: Ensures device upload fails if trust anchor does not match.

methods.name: testUploadMessageFailsForDisabledTenant
methods.description: Verifies rejection of messages from a disabled tenant.

methods.name: testUploadMessageFailsForDisabledDevice
methods.description: Verifies rejection from disabled device.

methods.name: testUploadMessageFailsForDisabledGateway
methods.description: Verifies rejection from disabled gateway device.

methods.name: testUploadMessageFailsForUnauthorizedGateway
methods.description: Ensures requests from unauthorized gateway are rejected.

methods.name: testHandleConcurrentUploadWithTtd
methods.description: Tests concurrent upload requests with TTD and command handling.

methods.name: testUploadMessagesWithTtdThatDoNotReplyWithCommand
methods.description: Checks that no command is sent when TTD expires without pending commands.

methods.name: testUploadMessagesWithTtdThatReplyWithCommand
methods.description: Tests command delivery with TTD, including command response handling.

methods.name: testUploadMessagesWithTtdThatReplyWithOneWayCommand
methods.description: Tests one-way command delivery and response.
